impact: greedy_noci 2x2-drop selection AND orbopt_noci objective use this wrong energy -> their atom ranking is unreliable. All prior timed_bench.csv / complete_ci CSV / checkpoint ENERGY and selection are INVALID for these two methods. FCI scoring itself is fine; ckpt Ritz on orthonormal V (eigh Q^dagger H Q) remains correct, but the SELECTION that chose atoms is not.
